title: 迦娜·风之高台
description: 浅发迦娜穿完整蓝白长袍静立高台，长杖竖直落地，发丝与衣摆向同一方向延展，强光形成清楚切面。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Janna is an adult wind spirit woman with long pale blond-white hair, pointed ears, luminous blue eyes, and flowing blue-white garments. Preserve her slender natural adult proportions and long crystal-topped staff. A fully covering long-sleeved robe with an opaque underlayer, covered legs, and shoes replaces revealing costume panels; the staff stays grounded vertically, with no active storm or attacking spell.
art_direction.scene: She stands motionless on a broad open terrace, one hand around the grounded staff and the free arm relaxed, looking toward distant cloud layers. A mild wind carries hair and robe ends in one clean diagonal. Strong cool side light carves coarse wax-crayon folds against a warm horizon, with sparse columns and open sky instead of swirling magical clutter.
art_direction.palette: silver white, pale blue, deep teal, warm horizon gold
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
